description: Listen writes the browser listen session (player-loop-playback.js with player-listen-session-helpers.js) and Android's ListenSessions.kt must both produce for the same playback steps. Bodies name tracks by playbackRef; the browser's path and cover_path are replaced by the reference the track has when the write is sent, exactly as the server resolves a reference back to the path; listenKey is the opaque identity Android tells one track by. A claim step is an acquire or heartbeat answer naming scrobbling.available. A fail step answers the next write of its effect with that status, error code and Retry-After; retry backoff is measured on the step clock with retryJitter as the random value. Writes are compared in order within each listen session.

scenarios.name: a gapless advance ends one listen and starts the next, and the queue end completes it
a pause checkpoints the listen and a resume continues it with later sequences
seeks split segments, underruns and seeks break contiguity, and another track ends the listen as skipped
a long track scrobbles at four minutes and a paused seek keeps the listen closed
transient failures back off: a 5xx now-playing is retried at a later position once due, a scrobble only after its backoff, a resume retries at once, and a failed completion is not retried
a short listen writes no history, a lost claim closes the listen, and nothing is written without ownership
Last.fm not connected: the listen sends no more now-playing or scrobble writes, its history is still written, and the next listen asks again
repeated 5xx scrobbles back off from five seconds, doubling, and are sent unchanged
a 429 waits for its Retry-After, and a refused now-playing is never sent again
a refreshed reference continues the same listen, and every later write names the new reference
an owner going away mid-play ends the listen with the unload checkpoint, and a short one writes none
the end of a listen sends a backed-off scrobble once more before its completion
scrobbling unavailable at the claim: the listen sends no now-playing or scrobble, its completions are still sent, and a listen begun after the claim reports it available writes them again
a now-playing Last.fm could not take for now (503) is retried after its backoff, and a rate-limited one after its Retry-After
a track of ten seconds or less is recorded only once heard to its end, and no track of thirty seconds or less scrobbles, even heard in full
